correctness.rationale: The explicit floor inequalities yield an induced squared eight-cycle for every integer p>=2 in the exact stated band. Summation of three-gap nonedge and two-gap edge inequalities proves the converse only for cyclic-order-preserving embeddings. The graph-link identity is elementary. The 4-dimensional squared-eight-cycle cut-complex has nonzero H_3 over F_2 by two independent exact chain enumerations, so cannot be shellable. The bundled checker verifies finite assumptions and linked faces, while the written proof handles all parameters.
